title: Modeling Profanity and Hate Speech in Social Media with Semantic Subspaces
benchmark_measurement: Error analysis of hate speech/profanity detection models, observing false positives triggered by religious terms.
findings: In a qualitative analysis of model errors, it was found that the models tend to misclassify neutrally-labeled tweets as offensive when they contain words related to religion. An example provided was the phrase 'No Good Friday agreement'.
